title: Huly header
description: Transparent dark header that floats over the hero: logo and wordmark, plain white links with dropdown chevrons, a star link and two small outline pills. On phones a two-line burger opens a full-width menu.
notes: dark by default (tone="dark" adds the dark class); use tone="inherit" on a light page
position="absolute" floats it over the next block; the chevrons are decoration, not dropdowns
